meta.title: How clamp bounds a value
meta.intent: Explain the interval contract, guard, and value transformation.

files.purpose: Validate the interval and bound the value

code.label: Guard the interval, then bound the value

visuals.title: Validate, then transform
visuals.caption: An inverted interval raises; a valid interval bounds the value.

nodes.label: Bound value
nodes.detail: Cap at upper, then floor at lower

steps.title: A valid interval bounds the value
steps.takeaway: The guard rejects inverted bounds before the value is transformed.
narrative: The function raises ValueError when lower exceeds upper. Otherwise, min caps the value at upper and max floors that result at lower.
Worked example, not a recorded execution: clamp(12, 0, 10) returns 10. Caller behavior and nonnumeric inputs are outside the supplied context.
